name: Ascent Echo
description: Cast an echo of rising light beside the student so that an opponent's soul-sense climbs after it.

name: Clean Outline
description: Hold up a clean outline of the student to a soul-bolt so that the bolt follows its edge and away.

name: Bright Pace
description: Cast a pace of bright light ahead and step along it to the far end in one breath.

name: Sapphire Retinue
description: Raise a retinue of sapphire phantoms round the student as a ring that bears a steady press of soul force.

name: Sharpened Double
description: Hone the double to a point and drive it into the soul of an opponent through a gap in the guard.

name: Lucid Shade
description: Hold a lucid shade over the field to show the student every soul in clear outline.

name: Radiant Procession
description: Walk a procession of radiant phantoms round the student so that opponents see nothing but light and strike the wrong figure.

name: Prismatic Break
description: Break a prismatic phantom against a guard so that its shards drive through every layer of the opponent's ward.

name: Prism Passage
description: Dissolve the body into its prismatic phantom for an instant and pass through a barrier of force whole.

name: Resplendent Phantasm
description: Raise the school's great phantasm out of the student's own light and burst it over the field so that every opponent is struck and blinded in soul-sense.

name: Stoic Double
description: Stand a stoic double before the student that bears a soul-strike without a flicker.

name: Settled Image
description: Settle an image into the student's exact stance so that an opponent reads one posture from two bodies.

name: Counted Stride
description: Take a measured pace through the double and come out beside it with the guard still raised.

name: Unmoving Likeness
description: Fix a likeness in place so firmly that a soul-strike finds nothing to push and fades against it.

name: Weighing Shade
description: Lay a weighing shade against an opponent and learn how much force the opponent's soul can bear.

name: Rebuking Echo
description: Loose a rebuking echo at the opponent who struck first so that the answer lands with a heavy knock.

name: Doubled Bulwark
description: Stand the doubles shoulder to shoulder in a bulwark that holds against a heavy and sustained soul-assault.

name: Doubled Reproach
description: Press the weight of the standing doubles on an opponent's soul until the opponent's technique sinks.

name: Immovable Double
description: Make the double a sink for hostile force so that every blow it takes is drawn in and held.

name: Choir of Doubles
description: Raise the whole line of doubles in one voice so that it turns every soul-strike aside and then sends the gathered force back across the field.

name: Walking Echo
description: Let an echo walk ahead and fold the student's stride into its own so the ground passes quickly.

name: Anchored Shade
description: Anchor a shade to the Core so that it stands unmoved by a soul-strike.

name: Deep Likeness
description: Sink a likeness into the soul-field and read what lies beneath the surface of each nearby soul.

name: Bearing Double
description: Strike with a double that bears the Core's weight so that the blow falls like the student's own.

name: Gathered Form
description: Gather the scattered echoes into one form and send it where the opponent least expects it.

name: Calm Phantom
description: Send a calm phantom to meet a soul-bolt and lead it gently out of line.

name: Lasting Image
description: Keep an image alive on the Core's stable strength through a long exchange without tiring.

name: Independent Phantom
description: Set a phantom to fight an opponent on its own while the student watches through its senses.

name: Phantom Onslaught
description: Send a vanguard of independent phantoms ahead to break an opposing line before the student arrives.

name: Roaming Entity
description: Pass the student's awareness into a roaming entity that crosses walls and wards and returns with all it has seen.

name: Walking Soul
description: Send a whole entity of the student's soul to walk and fight apart from the body and shelter the body with its weight.

name: Breaker Shade
description: Break a shade against an opponent's guard so that the shock runs through to the soul.

name: Thunder Pace
description: Throw a heavy echo ahead with a crack of force and ride its pull for one long pace.

name: Bracing Image
description: Brace the image against the student's chest so that it carries a soul-strike's weight.

name: Squall Likeness
description: Whip the likeness round the student in a squall so that the true body vanishes inside the motion.

name: Lashing Double
description: Lash the double across an opponent in a hard arc that cracks against the soul.

name: Eddy Shade
description: Spin the shade in an eddy that catches soul-bolts and sheds them to the side.

name: Cloudburst Phantoms
description: Let a cloudburst of phantoms fall over the opposing line and strike each soul it touches.

name: Squall Curtain
description: Wrap the student in a storm veil of phantoms that bars a strike and sheds what it cannot bar.

name: Squall Revenant
description: Gather the squall into one revenant and hurl it into a single opponent with the full cast of the school.

name: Stormbreaker Wraith
description: Drive the school's great wraith across the field like a front of storm so that guards break and every opponent it passes is pressed low.

name: Bonded Double
description: Show a double bonded to the student by a spoken word so that its every movement matches the student's.

name: Faithful Shade
description: Hold a faithful shade at the student's side that stays through every blow.

name: Keeper's Pace
description: Pace at the double's side and trade places with it at the word of command.

name: Accounting Shade
description: Send a shade to reckon with the soul of one who broke a covenant and strike it for the breach.

name: Honest Likeness
description: Hold an honest likeness before a speaker and feel it dim when the speaker lies.

name: Faith Echo
description: Echo the sworn word so that a soul-strike aimed at an oath-kin turns aside from them.

name: Wraith Covenant
description: Bind a wraith to the covenant of the sworn so that it shields them and steadies each of their techniques.

name: Oathkeeper Verdict
description: Pass the covenant's judgment on an oath-breaker with one heavy blow from the sworn double.

name: Covenant Phantasm
description: Cast the covenant as a phantasm that lies on an opponent's soul and presses down every technique the opponent tries.

name: Oath of Wraiths
description: Swear the whole company of wraiths to one oath so that they shield the sworn and hold a fallen member's soul for the span in which life may be won back.

name: Free Echo
description: Let a free echo run without a thread and take its place after it with one swift step.

name: Ranging Shade
description: Let a ranging shade cover the whole domain and report each soul that moves in it.

name: Loose Likeness
description: Loose a likeness to wander through the domain so that every opponent in it meets a different student.

name: Unleashed Double
description: Unleash the double on an opponent and let it choose its own opening.

name: Hovering Image
description: Hold an image hovering over the student's head where it intercepts any soul-strike from above.

name: Roving Eye
description: Send a roving eye through the domain to see what the student cannot.

name: Shifting Phantom
description: Shift the phantom's face from one opponent's memory to the next so that none can name it.

name: Independent Wraith
description: Leave an independent wraith to hold an opponent in a long fight while the student attends to another.

name: Phantom Flight
description: Launch a flight of phantoms from the domain's edge and strike every opponent that stands in the way.

name: Untethered Phantom
description: Cut the phantom loose of the body and let it pass through walls and wards to act far from the student.

name: Free Phantom
description: Release the school's free phantom to roam the domain and act on its own judgment for the length of a fight.
